plugins.name: design-system
plugins.description: Build, name, document, and audit UI components for design systems with expert ARIA and accessibility guidance. Trigger when the user mentions "design system", "component library", "pattern library", "UI kit", "ARIA pattern", "WAI-ARIA", "accessible component", "component taxonomy", "component API design", "design tokens", or "design system audit". Also trigger on questions like "what should I call this component", "how should this component work", "is this component accessible", or "review my component library". Trigger on shared markup when the user clearly wants design-system feedback on a reusable UI pattern. Do not trigger on general HTML/CSS questions unrelated to design-system patterns.

plugins.name: dreamlight-valley
plugins.description: Identify a Disney Dreamlight Valley recipe from a name, photo, or screenshot and return its ingredients, recommend recipes from the ingredients on hand (optimizing energy or Star Coin profit), or build a gather list from a storage screenshot. Use this whenever the user shows a DDV recipe, cookbook, or storage screenshot, names a Dreamlight Valley dish, or asks "what ingredients do I need for <dish>", "what can I cook with <ingredients>", "what should I cook", "most profitable thing to cook", or "best recipe for energy", or mentions Dreamlight Valley cooking, meals, or selling food for coins. A bare "what should I cook?" about a stockpile of ingredients ("a ton of tomatoes", "some spice") is a Dreamlight Valley question: use this skill. Do not trigger for real-world meal planning ("what can I make for dinner tonight"), recipes the user wants invented, or other games. Covers base game, Eternity Isle, Storybook Vale, and Wishblossom Mountains.

plugins.name: gh-notification-summary
plugins.description: Review, summarize, and manage GitHub notifications. Use this skill whenever the user mentions GitHub notifications, unread GitHub activity, open issues on their repos, or wants to catch up on project discussions — even if they don't use the word 'notifications'. Also trigger for /unsub <number>, 'mark all done', 'clear my GitHub inbox', or any request to triage, dismiss, or act on GitHub notifications.

plugins.name: install-guide-builder
plugins.description: Generate a printable, platform-split developer environment setup guide as a PDF (and optionally an interactive HTML page) covering tools like Git, Node, Python, PHP, Docker, databases, and their version managers. Use this whenever someone asks for install instructions, onboarding docs, a setup guide, a "getting started on a new laptop" document, a dev environment doc, machine setup steps, or wants to document how to install a toolchain for students, new hires, workshop attendees, or a team. Also use it when someone asks to add a tool to an existing setup guide, or to rewrite install steps for a different skill level or a different operating system. Trigger on phrases like "setup guide", "install instructions", "onboarding doc", "how do I document installing X", "environment setup", "new machine checklist", "get the team set up", or a bare list of tools plus an operating system.

plugins.name: structured-data
plugins.description: Inject, generate, audit, or fix schema.org structured data (JSON-LD script blocks, or Microdata itemscope/itemtype/itemprop attributes) in HTML, templates, React/Vue/Web Components, or static-site pipelines (Eleventy, Astro, Hugo). Load this before answering any structured-data question: its bundled validator catches value errors (durations, ingredient lists, missing required properties) that reading the markup misses. Use whenever the user asks to add schema.org markup, structured data, rich snippets, or rich results; pastes a JSON-LD block or itemprop markup and asks whether it is valid, broken, or correct; asks to audit, validate, or fix structured data; or asks to choose between Microdata and JSON-LD. Injection runs through the build-time or server-side scripts bundled here, never client-side JavaScript, since crawlers may index a page before hydration runs. Do not trigger for Open Graph or Twitter card meta tags, JSON Schema, or SEO advice with no schema.org markup involved.

plugins.name: webc-components
plugins.description: Author, debug, and review WebC (@11ty/webc) components with source-verified answers about how WebC compiles them. WebC's prop, slot, and bundling rules often differ from what general knowledge predicts, so load this before answering any WebC question. Use this whenever a message mentions WebC, a `.webc` file, WebC syntax (`@prop`, `:@prop`, `webc:setup`, `webc:if`, `webc:for`, `@html`, `@raw`, `@text`), or `@11ty/eleventy-plugin-webc`, including symptom questions with no file attached: a prop set to "false" that still acts true, a prop that is undefined, a slot fallback that never renders, a custom tag that appears or vanishes, one component's styles leaking into another, or a build error after editing a component. Trigger on phrases like "write a WebC component", "review this .webc", "set up my WebC conventions". Do not trigger for Eleventy configuration (`eleventy.config.js`, passthrough copy), Nunjucks or Liquid templates, Lit or other component libraries, or ARIA questions with no WebC involved.
